newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Agalawatte dips 2.24 pct on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Agalawatte dips 2.24 pct on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares of Agalawatte Plantations fell 2.24 percent, or 75 cents, to 32.75 on Tuesday in early profit-taking, brokers said.
"Retailers are taking profit as they see 32 rupees as a benchmark price for the share, due to a parcel of 3.8 million Agalawatte being on bid at that price," said a local broker.
The parcel of 3.8 million Agalawatte shares has been on bid since Friday on an all-or-nothing basis.
Agalawatte is one of six privatised plantation firms trading in Colombo.
